release.name: rapp-static-brainstem 1.1.0 — attach one SKILL.md
release.body:
**Attach one file.** `SKILL.md` (below) carries the whole brainstem: soul, agents and runner, embedded with one command that checks its SHA-256 and unpacks them. Attach it to any AI host that can run Python but can't fetch links, and say: "Follow this SKILL.md and run the Probe agent with nonce any-text-you-choose." A matching SHA-256 of your nonce shows the agent really ran.

- `SKILL.md`: the one-file bundle (same as `bundle/SKILL.md` at this tag). SHA-256 `eeb0ac56f74ed754fbbcecb2bd7c4a9c1127f0716b9a6432e3246825bbc08b36`.
- `rapp-static-brainstem-skill.zip`: the same files as a zip. SHA-256 `30472dc0dfadde7431a91594042c5fb3ac678034728e3a3ff44a05fdbbd7b76e`.

Also new: the bundle is skipped (with a status note) if it would pass 512 KB, every file it carries is secret-scanned, unpacking refuses unsafe paths and an existing folder, and published files get the usual permissions. 47 tests on Python 3.10 and 3.x.

Hosts that read links can still use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/rapp-static-brainstem/v1.1.0/SKILL.md.

Non-authoritative discovery. Signed RAPP/1 frames and signed RAPP/1 registries remain the authority.
